notes.title: Follow CI Games homepage on Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25864412/5789a1afc539ee1b49b1261713c5e8eea81514ec.jpg
Dear Players!

We are happy to announce that we are ready with our homepage on Steam!

We really like the new Steam feature and thus, we would like to invite you all to follow the 
homepage, so that you are always up to date with the latest announcements from our studio. Also, feel free to join our new group, where we can discuss diverse topics about CI Games and our titles.

See you around!
